_comment: Edit this file to add, remove, or update brokers. 'method' is one of: form, email, drop. Opt-out URLs and email addresses change over time — verify periodically. This is seed data, not legal advice.

brokers.name: Spokeo
brokers.notes: Find your listing, copy the URL, then submit it on the opt-out page. Confirmation by email.

brokers.name: Whitepages
brokers.notes: Requires a phone verification call to finish. Keep your phone handy.

brokers.name: BeenVerified
brokers.notes: Search your name, select your record, verify by email link.

brokers.name: TruePeopleSearch
brokers.notes: Fast. Enter your record URL and confirm the code they email you.

brokers.name: FastPeopleSearch
brokers.notes: Find your listing first, then submit its URL for removal.

brokers.name: PeopleFinders
brokers.notes: Search, claim your record, confirm by email.

brokers.name: Radaris
brokers.notes: Create the removal request from your profile page.

brokers.name: Intelius
brokers.notes: Part of the PeopleConnect group; one removal may cover several sites.

brokers.name: PeekYou
brokers.notes: Submit the unique ID from your profile URL.

brokers.name: MyLife
brokers.notes: No self-serve form. Email them and follow up by phone if ignored.

brokers.name: Acxiom
brokers.notes: Marketing broker feeding many mailing lists. Opt out of all use.

brokers.name: Epsilon
brokers.notes: Request deletion and suppression from marketing databases.

brokers.name: LexisNexis
brokers.notes: Removal is limited by law for some record types, but worth filing.

brokers.name: California DROP
brokers.notes: One state-run request covers every registered broker in California. California residents only.
